source: The collection address was only a shortened form ('0x7e50…195c') and had not been re-verified on-chain. Derived live via a read-only eth_call against the public RPC https://mainnet.base.org (no API key) at Base block 51590601: Pair(0xE8143126bdFBe58ED0056f88031236766C311ECf).token0() = 0x4200000000000000000000000000000000000006 (WETH, the chain registry's quoteToken) and .token1() = 0xA9f3F136380E53F8f55CaD44391bDa2B617D7C83 (the non-WETH side, i.e. the wrapper). WERC721(wrapper).collection() then read as 0x7e50af303A0422ebec6bc198034A2430bBe0195c, checksummed via viem's getAddress — matches the shortened form's first-4/last-4 hex exactly, confirming it. wrapper.name()/symbol() and collection.name()/symbol() were also read live in the same session (rate-limited once at 429 on the free RPC tier; retried successfully ~5s later). Reserves are the historical pool-only snapshot for the Base pool ETH/DEMON — a live balance changes constantly and is not what this fixture exists to pin down; only the collection address derivation above was newly verified this session.
